name: Ondřej Kolář - § 47 - Am 15
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Bosnia and Herzegovina
part_text: 47. Recalls the need for efficient migration and asylum management, effective border control and an effective returns policy; is worried about the rise in migrant smuggling and the increasing involvement of various international actors, often drawn from migrant populations; notes that criminal groups now include smugglers from Iraq, Syria, Afghanistan, Morocco, Algeria, Türkiye and the Netherlands; hopes that Bosnia and Herzegovina’s upgraded status agreement with Frontex will contribute to the prevention of illegal migration and the strengthening of the security of the region; urges Bosnia and Herzegovina to step up its efforts against cross-border crime, especially human trafficking; considers that, in order to reduce economic incentives, essential actions include tracking and seizing smuggling profits and financial disruption in general;
